QuestInfo.name: Sea Firefly 2
QuestInfo.0: You should be getting the bottle back from Olaf and heading back to the Nautilus...
QuestInfo.1: Olaf gave the magic flask back to you, filled with the Vigor of the Sea. You'd better get the bottle to #bSharyl, the Prince of Whales#k right away, before it starts getting dark. \n\n#i4031842##t4031842# #b#c4031842##k / 1
QuestInfo.2: As the Vigor of the Sea is unleashed in The Nautilus, the overall atmosphere turns bright. But why is it that Sharyl, the Prince of Whales is blushing while saying that Kyrin should be so happy?

0.0: The Magic Flask has been filled with the Vigor of the Sea. Are you ready to return to Nautilus?

yes.0: Here it is. Take it to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales.

no.0: Talk to me again when you are ready. The Prince is in a hurry, so we should probably prepare quickly...

1.0: Ahhh you brought it! The Nautilus will be dim no more!

yes.0: I am sure Kyrin will be relieved of this. Hopefully she'll be happy with what's about to take place.

npc.0: You still haven't left? Hurry up and give the Vigor of the Sea to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales.

lost.0: Oh no, did you lose it?

yes.0: You have to put in a lot of effort to collect the Vigor of the Sea. It's very precious, so please be careful not to lose it again.
